name: the record has no page id
why: Every history module asks by page id, read from WIKIREQUEST.info.pageId in the page's script; without it the window has no History section.

name: the section starts open
why: Mockup M4: closed, read when it opens, so a window costs no history request.

name: opening the section reads nothing
why: The section's toggle starts the read (_bbHistStart()).

name: a failed list is asked again by a re-open
why: The toggle also fires on every repaint that draws the section open; only a click may retry, or a failing page loops.

name: a failed source is asked again by a repaint
why: The same rule for a revision's source: Load 20 more repaints twice and must not ask the failed 46 again.

name: the predecessor on the next page is not read
why: The oldest row of the pages read needs the revision before it, the first row of the next list page.

edits.find: if (!h.revs[i + 1] && cur.n > 0 && h.read < h.pages && !h.more) await _bbHistLoadList(pid, h.read + 1);

name: the pager's links are not counted
why: Page 1's pager says "page 1" only; its links say there are 3.

name: the source keeps the newline after <div>
why: div.page-source opens with a newline: without dropping it every line number is one off and line 1 is blank.

name: no line is paired as changed
why: A removed and an added line that are close become one changed line, its words marked.
grep: the readers|a window: the section|a revision picked

name: the changed words are not marked
why: Inside a changed line the added and removed words carry mb-dgh-add / mb-dgh-rem.
grep: a window: the section|a revision picked

name: the unchanged lines are not folded
why: Only what changed (the default) folds them into "⋯ N unchanged lines".

name: a refusal reads as an error
why: vzell's answer 4: a permission answer shows "Sign in to Brucebase to see the history".

name: no ✎ in a Brucebase window
why: ✎ and H open the History section (_dpHasHistory()).

name: the ☰ entry asks the source's resolve()
why: resolve() refuses a link outside a table on a touch screen: the entry would never exist on a phone.

name: the setting is ignored
why: sa_bb_history off: no section, no entry, no request.
